notes.title: Patch 5 notes
notes.notes:
A new month, a new patch. 

This update comes with lots of new fixes and additions, but this time around we have decided to focus on UI. Thanks again for your patience. 

Courage and honour! 

🖥️ User Interface 

Added an interactive progress widget for the “Hold to Collect Servo Skull” action. 

Subtitles now appear in prerendered videos and subtitle timing has been improved. 

Weapon radial menu now greys out unusable weapons. 

Network lag indicator added. 

Password prompt scaling issues resolved. 

Tooltip visibility restored across various menus. 

Chapter checkpoint descriptions now appear as tooltips. 

Audio Log screen redesigned to reflect the original game, with past voice lines now visible. 

DPad icons updated with new button glyphs for clearer navigation. 

Weapon ammo values now padded (e.g., 09/10). 

Terms of Service dialog and account unlinking button added to Options menu. 

Opacity reduced for unavailable player spawn options. 

Tutorial screen requests now ignored during fades or cinematics. 

Added SFX on several menus. 

Fixed various chat-related issues. 

🗺️ Other 

Fixed softlock issue in the Terms of Service screen. 

Fixed out-of-bounds death fall in Chapter 7.

notes.title: Patch 3 notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for your patience! Patch 3 is finally here. We have been working on a number of fixes that we hope will make your experience better. Enjoy!



🌍 Localisation 

• Updated Dutch, Polish, and Italian translations. 

• Improved localisation for game modes, controller options, and key terms (e.g. Skar Boyz). 

🧭 UI/UX Enhancements 

Major improvements to chat input, scoreboard layout, and HUD elements. 

Added glow effects, spacing fixes, and better alignment across menus. 

Improved mission selection, unlock notifications, and subtitle persistence. 

Added new button prompts, SFX, and controller glyphs (including Steam Deck and Switch Pro). 

Fixed softlocks, graphical glitches, and input issues in various screens. 

⚔️ Gameplay Fixes 

Fixed softlock in Exterminatus wave 5. 

Restored coop live tokens and fixed weapon wheel ammo display. 

Improved challenge decorators and shield visualisers. 

Fixed campaign info and map loading inconsistencies. 

Legacy black screen issue fixed 

🎮 Platform & Controller Support 

Steam Deck now launches correctly. 

Improved controller disconnect handling on PC. 

🌐 Networking 

Fixed session code visibility in streamer mode. 

Improved EOS invite handling and native session stability. 

Disabled team auto-balancing during gameplay. 

Enhanced P2P connection handling to prevent lobby splits. 

🛠️ Technical & Build 

Moved local user profile data to AppData to prevent config crashes. 

Added memory safety for loadouts and improved fade animations. 

🔊 Audio & Visual 

Fixed missing or duplicate SFX events. 

Updated button textures and fixed VFX issues.

notes.title: Refunds, Discounts & Patch Plans
notes.notes:
🛠️ Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition – Refunds, Discounts & Patch Plans 

Hi everyone, 
 
We’ve got some important updates to share for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine: Master Crafted Edition, including an extended refund policy, details on a 50% upgrade path discount, and a preview of the patch improvements coming soon. 

💸 Refunds & Upgrade Discount – What You Need to Know 

We’ve heard your concerns around pricing, and we want to be clear about the steps we’re taking to address them. 

🟦 Extended Refund Window – Until July 10 

If you’ve already purchased Space Marine: Master Crafted Edition, you are eligible for a full refund, regardless of playtime, as long as you request it before 6pm BST/10pm PST July 10 2025 (when the Steam Summer Sale ends). 

🔗 Request Your Refund via Steam Support 

🟨 50% Upgrade Discount 

• If you own Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition, you’re eligible for a 50% discount when buying the Master Crafted Edition from 6pm BST/10pm PST June 26 2025 until 6pm BST/10pm PST July 10 2025 when the discount offer ends. 
• New buyers who already own the original game will see the discount automatically applied at checkout. 
• If you already purchased the Master Crafted Edition and qualify for the discount, you’ll need to: 
  1. Request a refund manually via Steam Support (before July 10) 
  2. Then re-purchase the game at the discounted price. 
 
We know this situation has been frustrating for some of you, and we’re sorry for the confusion it’s caused. We hope this approach offers a workable solution while we continue improving the game itself. 

🔧 Patch Roadmap – Improvements Incoming 

Thanks for all your feedback. We’re rolling out a series of patches over the coming weeks to improve the experience across the board: 

🌍 Localisation 

• Updated Dutch, Polish, and Italian translations.

Improved mission selection, unlock notifications, and subtitle persistence. 

Added new button prompts, SFX, and controller glyphs (including Steam Deck and Switch Pro).

Improved challenge decorators and shield visualisers. 

Fixed campaign info and map loading inconsistencies.
